idea-plugin.name: DOT Studio
idea-plugin.description:
Support for Graphviz DOT files (.dot, .gv). In development; no features are available yet.

Planned for the first release:

  • Syntax highlighting, folding, structure view, brace matching and commenting for DOT files
  • A live preview in a split editor that renders in the background, with zoom, pan and a layout engine picker
  • A bundled renderer, so no Graphviz installation is needed
  • SVG and PNG export

Source code and issue tracker: github.com/acalebratliff/dot-studio
